attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:'), which breaks character and wrongly labels the League fact as old news. It is also crammed into two blocks instead of 2–3 separate items, runs just under the word floor, and has only faint wit; the 'trouble brewing' line stays hedged speculation."}
